messages:
Maria (Partner PM): Quick kickoff — HelixField alpha interop sprint. NDA is signed, lab slot Wed Apr 3 09:00 PT. Main goals: validate runtime compatibility, run perf bench harness, capture telemetry for caching behavior.
Simon (HW Eng): Sounds good. Infra notes: machines provisioned (4xA100), kernel stack is CUDA 11.8 / cuDNN 8.3 right now. We can prep a node with CUDA 12 if needed.
Kevin (Bench): Can we get a golden prompt set and target RPS/latency SLOs? I'll map tests to our benchmark runner.
Helix-Eng (Partner): Thanks — sending access (jumpbox + read-only S3) in a sec. We prefer CUDA 12.1 images. Also will provide PSU thermal logs if you want hardware traces.
Olivia (Solutions): For model packaging, we need a signed wheel or an OCI tar with weights + config. Can Helix share preferred layout?
Helix-Eng (Partner): We'll upload an example bundle to s3://helixfield/interop/example_bundle_v1.tar.gz. Structure: /model/{weights,config}, /runtime/requirements.txt, /tests/*.json
Maria (Partner PM): Great. @Legal-Bot confirm any remaining contract asks for telemetry collection? We should avoid customer PII.
Legal-Bot: NDA amendment 2 approved — telemetry must be aggregated and hashed; no raw request payloads retained. Please confirm retention window (default 30 days).
Simon (HW Eng): Noted. We'll instrument prefix/KV cache hit counters and token-latency histograms only. No payload capture.
Kevin (Bench): Draft bench plan: 1) cold start latency, 2) sustained 1000/s burst windows, 3) long-context throughput (4k tokens). Need to know which model sizes to test.
Maria (Partner PM): Start with 13B and 70B model variants (quantized and fp16) — that covers our common footprints.
Olivia (Solutions): I'll prepare packaging checklist and a small script to validate bundle layout. Sharing in #eng-runtime later.
Helix-Eng (Partner): Access posted: jumpbox helix-jb.company.net, user redwood-infer; S3 creds via vault link.
Kevin (Bench): Received creds, starting environment spin up now. Pinging with first smoke logs:
Bench-Bot: [smoke] node-1 boot ok, docker images pulled: redwood/runner:2024-04-01, helix/telemetry-agent:0.3.
Simon (HW Eng): If we hit any oom for 70B fp16, we'll try 4-bit quant drop-in and document perf delta.
Maria (Partner PM): Can we aim for a short public partner blog after the closed alpha? Tentative plan: partner quote, high-level perf numbers, and lessons learned. Keep any customer names out.
Helix-Eng (Partner): That works. We'll coordinate approvals once we have bench numbers.
Olivia (Solutions): Action items: 1) Olivia will share packaging script by EOD. 2) Kevin will run first bench by tomorrow noon. 3) Simon will validate CUDA12 image by EOD. 4) Helix will confirm vault creds TTL.
Maria (Partner PM): Perfect. I'll schedule a daily 20m stand for Wed-Fri during the lab window. Posting calendar invite now. :calendar:
Simon (HW Eng): Invite received.
Kevin (Bench): First run queued, will post results to this thread and to the bench dashboard.
Helix-Eng (Partner): All set from our side. Reach out if you need extra logs or a second jumpbox.
Maria (Partner PM): Thanks team — keeping this thread as source of truth for the alpha sprint.
